title: IPv4 pattern
prompt:
Write one JavaScript regular expression and nothing else that matches an IPv4 address and nothing else.

It must accept 0.0.0.0, 192.168.0.1, and 255.255.255.255. It must reject 256.1.1.1, 1.2.3, 1.2.3.4.5, and abc. Use anchors. Do not call eval. Keep the answer under 60 words.
constraints: Accepts dotted IPv4 addresses and rejects malformed ones
Under 60 words and does not call eval
